summary: Plain west kerb on a busy road, houses behind hedges within 25 m.

drivers.seclusion: Hedged houses on the west side close to the kerb; houses also across the road to the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide kerbside lane beside the road; a parked car is visible nearby in QLD imagery.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with lane markings; constant passing traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; cars park along the kerb but no overnight convention evident.

flags: Low-lying: about 6-7 m, Sandy Creek 88 m away
sun_shade: Mostly open; hedge and trees shade the west side in the morning.

best_section.where: west kerb just north of the side-street junction, beside the hedge
